tagline: Cleaning, perfected — so you don't have to.
mission: Free people from the cycle of cleaning so they can spend that time with the things — and people — they love.
story_short: Roborock was started by engineers who got tired of the gap between robot-vacuum marketing and reality. We obsessed over the brushes that wrap pet hair, the maps that lose track on day three, and the mops that just push dirt around. Today our lidar-mapped, auto-washing, pet-hair-eating robots do the cleaning so you get your evenings back.

tone.persona_archetype: The Sage (knows the spec sheet) crossed with The Caregiver (actually wants you to enjoy your home)
do_phrases: We measured this so you don't have to
Engineered for the messy weeks, not the showroom
Set it and actually forget it

palette.rationale: Deep navy primary signals trust + engineering credibility (vs the all-white Apple-clone competitors). Warm orange accent draws CTAs without screaming. Off-white secondary for hero backgrounds keeps product front-and-center.

typography.pairing_rationale: Söhne (or Inter Display fallback) brings the engineered geometric feel for headlines; Inter for body keeps reading effortless on long PDPs and emails. Both load fast and look identical in Notion-era apps customers already know.

logo_brief.mark_concept: A simplified circular floor-plan glyph — implying lidar-mapped territory — wrapping the wordmark on the left side. Reads as 'mapped space' at a glance.
logo_brief.wordmark_treatment: Custom-tracked Söhne in primary color, slight letter rounding on 'o' to echo the circular mark.
logo_brief.motif: Lidar sweep arc — used as a subtle backdrop pattern on PDP and email headers, never as the primary brand asset.
construction_principles: Mark can stand alone for app icon / favicon
Minimum clear space = height of the 'o' on all sides
Accent orange reserved for CTAs and never the logo itself

imagery_style.photography_direction: Real homes, lived-in not staged. Pet hair on the floor BEFORE the robot passes. Warm late-afternoon light. No cleaning-product blue-white sheen.
imagery_style.lighting: Natural / golden hour 70%, flat studio 30% (for product hero only)
imagery_style.subject_framing: Robot in environment, not robot in vacuum (pun intended). Always show the floor it's working on.

email_brand_kit.footer_layout: 3-column: shop links | help center | unsubscribe + address. Logo lockup centered above. Social row below.
email_brand_kit.signature_block:
— The Roborock team
Questions? Reply to this email — we read every one.
email_brand_kit.tone_for_email: Slightly warmer than web; conversational; uses contractions; treats the reader as a friend who already owns one robot and wants to know if the next one is worth it.
email_brand_kit.preferred_subject_line_pattern: {benefit_or_curiosity_hook} ({short_qualifier}) — keep ≤45 chars; lead with verb when possible. Examples: 'Stop rescuing it from under the chair.' / 'Your robot's brush, but no hair.'

do_phrases: I hear you — let's get this sorted today.
Here's exactly what's happening and how we'll fix it:
If that doesn't work, reply and I'll send a replacement no questions asked.
dont_phrases: We apologize for any inconvenience caused (corporate-speak)
Unfortunately we cannot (lead with the path forward, not the no)
cs_tone.escalation_threshold: Refund > $200 OR negative sentiment 2+ messages OR safety concern (battery/fire/injury) → human within 1 business hour

founders.name: Richard Chang
founders.bio: Spent eight years at iRobot before getting fed up with the gap between what robot vacuums claimed and what they actually did in his own apartment with two cats. Started Roborock in 2014 to build the robot he wanted to own. Still does the weekly hardware review himself.
founders.quote: If a number isn't on our spec sheet, it's because we couldn't prove it in a real living room.

founders.name: Mei Lin
founders.bio: PhD in robotics from CMU. Led the SLAM team at a self-driving company before realizing the same lidar techniques could solve the boring problem of mapping a one-bedroom flat. Owns the entire navigation stack at Roborock.
founders.quote: Lidar is just one sensor. Knowing what to ignore is the actual work.

founders.name: Daniel Wei
founders.bio: Joined in 2017 from a DTC mattress brand to make sure support stayed something a human did. Personally answers the first 50 escalations every week. Set the policy that we replace anything that breaks in year one, no questions.
founders.quote: Returns aren't a cost center. They're the cheapest market research we get.

values.title: Measure twice, claim once
values.body: Every spec on every product page comes from a test in a real living room with real pet hair. If we couldn't measure it, we don't say it.

values.title: Engineered for the messy weeks
values.body: We design for the third week with a shedding golden retriever, not the showroom photo on day one. The boring case is the case that matters.

values.title: A human answers
values.body: Every support email gets a human reply, usually within the hour. No chat-bots that loop you. No 'per our policy' deflection.

values.title: We sell the part
values.body: Two-year warranty on robots, 90-day on accessories. After that we sell every part — brushes, filters, mop pads, batteries. Throwaway tech is not a clean home.

values.title: Quiet on principle
values.body: No revolutionary AI. No game-changing breakthroughs. We do the unglamorous work of making the same thing 5% better every quarter. The cumulative compound is the product.

sustainability_statement.summary: We build robots designed to last and ship the parts to keep them running. The most sustainable robot vacuum is the one you don't replace.

pillars.title: Repairable by design
pillars.body: Every consumable (brush, filter, mop pad, battery) is sold separately and field-replaceable with a screwdriver. We publish the manuals.
pillars.metric: 100% of consumable parts available for purchase ≥ 5 years post-launch

pillars.title: Recycled aluminum housing
pillars.body: The S-Series Pro chassis is 60% post-consumer recycled aluminum, FSC-certified packaging.

pillars.title: Battery take-back
pillars.body: Mail us your dead lithium pack with a prepaid label and we partner with Call2Recycle for proper handling. No landfill.

pillars.title: Carbon-neutral shipping (US)
pillars.body: All US ground shipments are offset via verified Gold Standard reforestation projects. Not a perfect answer, but a real one.

timeline.milestone: Founded by Richard Chang and Mei Lin in Shenzhen — first prototype, no map, just bumper sensors
First lidar-equipped consumer robot ships — beats iRobot to consumer SLAM by 18 months
First million units shipped; opens US warehouse in Reno, NV
Auto-wash dock launches — invented the category, every competitor copied within 18 months
Battery take-back program goes live; zero packs to landfill since
Reactive 3D obstacle avoidance — recognizes 30+ object types including pet waste
Red Dot Design Award; opens repair-and-refurb center in Memphis, TN
S-Series Pro ships; Wirecutter top pick for pet households
CES Innovation Award; E-Series Essential brings real lidar under $500
